Name: CustomPaths
Author: Entoarox
Description:
CustomPaths enables the use of ContentPacks that add new types of path to the game.

[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://github.com/pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url]﻿.[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI at least once to initialise the mod.
[/list]Once installed, you can add content packs that use Custom Paths

[b]Documentation for modders[/b]
A example content pack can be downloaded at the following url:
[url=http://cdn.kvdk.net/files/CustomPathsExampleCP.zip]http://cdn.kvdk.net/files/CustomPathsExampleCP.zip[/url]
